Fcg Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 15.15% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 22,156 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.37 million, down from 26,112 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fcg Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $897.19B market cap company. The stock increased 0.35% or $0.61 during the last trading session, reaching $176.82. About 28.40M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
South Texas Money Management Ltd increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 2.28% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC.
